title: dattri-LLM: A Unified and Efficient Library for Training Data Attribution at LLM Scale
abstract: arXiv:2609.38767v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Training data attribution (TDA) estimates the contribution of individual training examples to model outputs. Most scalable TDA methods rely on per-example gradients, whose computation and use at LLM scale pose challenges in efficiency, compatibility, and extensibility. We introduce dattri-LLM, a TDA library that makes gradient-based attribution more practical at scale. For efficiency, dattri-LLM uses compact gradient representations and dynamically routes gradient operations based on a cost model. For compatibility, its capture mechanism collects per-example gradients from existing training loops that call backward(), without requiring changes to the loop or its configuration. This includes distributed training with DDP and FSDP and pipelines built with HuggingFace Transformers, TRL, and OLMo. translated_title: dattri-LLM：面向LLM规模训练数据归因的统一高效库
translated_abstract: 训练数据归因（TDA）旨在估计单个训练样本对模型输出的贡献。大多数可扩展的TDA方法依赖于逐样本梯度，而这类梯度在大语言模型（LLM）规模下的计算和使用在效率、兼容性和可扩展性方面带来了挑战。我们提出了dattri-LLM，一个使基于梯度的归因在大规模场景下更加实用的TDA库。在效率方面，dattri-LLM使用紧凑的梯度表示，并基于代价模型动态路由梯度操作。在兼容性方面，其捕获机制能够从调用backward()的现有训练循环中收集逐样本梯度，而无需对训练循环或其配置进行任何修改，包括使用DDP和FSDP的分布式训练，以及基于HuggingFace Transformers、TRL和OLMo构建的训练流水线。在可扩展性方面，dattri-LLM提供了可复用的梯度操作和训练时回调，用于实现归因方法及相关应用……
tldr: dattri-LLM是一个统一的TDA库，通过紧凑梯度表示、基于代价模型的动态梯度操作路由以及无需修改训练循环的逐样本梯度捕获机制，使基于梯度的训练数据归因在LLM规模下实现高效、兼容且可扩展。
en_tdlr: dattri-LLM is a unified TDA library that makes gradient-based training data attribution practical at LLM scale through compact gradient representations, cost-model-based dynamic routing of gradient operations, and seamless per-example gradient capture from existing training loops without any modification.
